steps.sql: SELECT a FROM (VALUES (3, 1, N'c'), (1, 2, N'a'), (2, 1, NULL)) t(a, b, s) ORDER BY 'x'

SELECT a FROM (VALUES (3, 1, N'c'), (1, 2, N'a'), (2, 1, NULL)) t(a, b, s) ORDER BY CAST(1 AS int) + 2
SELECT a FROM (VALUES (3, 1, N'c'), (1, 2, N'a'), (2, 1, NULL)) t(a, b, s) ORDER BY -2

SELECT CAST(NULL AS int) AS k, a FROM (VALUES (3, 1, N'c'), (1, 2, N'a'), (2, 1, NULL)) t(a, b, s) ORDER BY 1, 2 DESC
SELECT a, a FROM (VALUES (3, 1, N'c'), (1, 2, N'a'), (2, 1, NULL)) t(a, b, s) ORDER BY a

DECLARE @k int = 1; SELECT a FROM (VALUES (3, 1, N'c'), (1, 2, N'a'), (2, 1, NULL)) t(a, b, s) ORDER BY a, @k
